children.title: Cycle 2 · Investigating the Levels of Information Activity and Persistent Identity

detail.title: Investigating the Levels of Information Activity and Persistent Identity
detail.summary: We synthesize initial findings from collected literature on information storage levels, examining how multi-level information activities such as memory storage contribute to the cognitive subject's psychological construction.

children.title: Cycle 1 · Investigating Memory and Persistent Identity in Computational Processes

detail.title: Investigating Memory and Persistent Identity in Computational Processes
detail.summary: This cycle establishes a research project under the 'memory_and_identity' topic to investigate the distinction between mere memory storage and persistent identity, utilizing collected evidence on multi-level information activities.
